independence_requirement: no prior access to runs/, private raw stores, or repair notes; starts from the public or double-blind bundle
reviewer_role: operator who did not conduct, curate, analyze, or package the original sessions, on a machine that is not the campaign machine
reviewer_tasks: sign the RPR-10 declaration of roles, prior access, conflicts, bundle id, host and environment id
bootstrap from the bundle and retain logs, inventory, attestation, commands, downloads, overrides, retries, failures, final hashes (RPR-11)
regenerate main tables and figures with one command and report each CON-5 layer separately (bit-exact, cadence, physics tolerance, statistical outcome)
report documentation gaps and support contacts
self_attestation: forbidden: owner self-review, synthetic signatures, and admin merges do not satisfy this gate
status: open: no reviewer engaged; nothing here is a review
title: Independent reproduction of the primary cells on a second machine
what_the_maintainer_may_do: answer documented questions; never edit the reviewer's environment, record, or result in place
what_the_reviewer_signs: a machine-readable reproduction record per SPEC 530 with layered comparison results and the signed declaration
